title: 跨境就医：成本可降四成，香港人为何纷纷北上？
speaker: Jason Salar

segments.en: Yeah, absolutely. And a really interesting trend that we're now seeing, driven by some of the affordability issues, is that people are now going across the border to seek health care.
segments.zh: 是的，绝对。由于可负担性问题，我们现在看到一个有趣的趋势：人们开始跨境寻求医疗服务。

segments.en: One of my colleagues said that he goes through his dental checks across the border. It's a 45-minute drive.
segments.zh: 我的一位同事说，他会跨境去做牙科检查，开车只需45分钟。

segments.en: So we see that as a great opportunity. We're doing more to partner with providers in China. We also have our own joint venture in China. We've been in China 23 years.
segments.zh: 我们认为这是一个巨大的机会。我们正在与中国内地服务商加强合作，而且我们在中国有自己的合资公司，已经深耕23年。

segments.en: There's the opportunity to leverage the partnerships and the relationships that they have. So having lived and worked in Hong Kong for many years, that's probably one of the biggest changes I'm now seeing is this whole mobility is real.
segments.zh: 我们可以利用他们的合作伙伴关系。我在香港生活工作多年，现在看到的最大变化之一就是这种流动性正在成为现实。

segments.en: It was something that was talked about for many years but we're actually seeing it happening there. Talk to us a bit more about how that would work in practice and also to your earlier point about the focus on affordability and cost savings potentially from AI.
segments.zh: 多年来人们一直在谈论，现在我们真的看到它发生了。请再谈谈这在实践中如何运作，以及您之前提到的AI可能带来的成本节省。

segments.en: Would you be able to put some numbers to it on how this might reshape the game going forward for a company like Signal?
segments.zh: 您能否给出一些数字，说明这将如何重塑像信诺这样的公司未来的格局？

segments.en: I haven't got specific numbers that I can share, but obviously, again, if we look at, like I said, even something like dental, et cetera, there could be material savings for individuals, 30%, 40% cheaper if they don't mind, like I said, driving across the border to seek those type of treatments.
segments.zh: 我没有具体数字可以分享，但显然，即使像牙科这样的项目，如果人们不介意跨境治疗，个人可以节省30%到40%的费用。

segments.en: Obviously, quality is also top of mind for us as well. So again, we have our approved providers that we work with which enables us to combine both quality and cost as well.
segments.zh: 显然，质量也是我们最关心的。我们有经过认证的服务商，能够兼顾质量和成本。
